title: All Of GlitchL0rd
description: A Collection of All of My Mods Which Enchance Vanilla Gameplay
body:
Adds an End ore: Enderlyth (Extremely Rare) Asscociated blocks and items and armor + Advancememnts, and it also adds Gapple Juice!!! To get Armor or Tools Use the Netherite Tool Or piece of armor in a smithing table with the Netherite upgrade template and a piece of Enderlyth To get Gapple Juice brew an Enchanted Golden Apple in the Brewing Stand

Tip: The block of Enderlyth gives Lvl.30 Enchants When near an Enchant Table Tip: Reinforced Endstone is Really Unbreakable!

Adds Copper Tools, Weapons and Armor That's It! Copper Tools/Armor Are a new variant of armor that's in the middle of iron tier and diamond tier! Use copper ingots to craft Tools/Armor just like any Armor!

Did You Ever Dream of Mojang adding Ice caves? (me too  :( ) but they just won't add them! But I Will! Presenting My Third Mod: Simply Ice Caves!

Ever dreamed of Emerald or Cobblestone Armor But MOJANG JUST WONT ADD IT?

Well I will:

Adds: Emerald gear tier (Between Diamond and Netherite)

Cobblestone Tier (Complete Crap For Noobs)

tip* Emerald Gear is Crafted like normal gear, and so is cobblestone

If netherite is to hard for you to get and diamond is just too weak use emerald gear

And if you cant get iron earlygame use cobblestone armor

Made With MCreator By _Sevaisbetter_
